messages:
Alex Chen: hey team — heads up: new on-call shadow (Priya) starts tomorrow morning. can we confirm primary/secondary for Fri night and who will do the formal handoff? cc @Mira @Sam :wave:
Mira Patel: I can take primary Fri 18:00-02:00 if Sam is ok with secondary. I’ll do a quick runbook walk at 17:30 with Priya.
Sam Ortiz: secondary works for me. I’ll be reachable via phone and PD. leaving a note about escalation thresholds. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident bot: Reminder: upcoming handoff window starts in 12 hours — use /handoff to register.
Jess Rivera: if Sam is secondary can you also confirm who will cover the DB alerts? last time there was a gap on slow queries.
Alex Chen: good call. Mira — can you own DB-alerts for the shift? Mira Patel: yep I’ll own DB alerts and the slow-queries runbook. link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slow-queries :eyes:
Priya Kapoor: thanks all — excited to shadow. quick question: what’s the expected first-call behavior? should I watch but not ack until Mira asks?
Mira Patel: you should watch and call out observations. Priya, if I say 'take it' you can ack and start mitigation with me next to you. We’ll pair on the first page.
Sam Ortiz: FYI — escalation path: primary -> secondary -> SRE lead (Jess) -> paged paging-oncall@redwood.com after 20 mins. Keep comms in #incidents for anything customer-impacting.
Alex Chen: adding a small checklist for the handoff (I'll paste):
```
- 17:30 runbook walk (screen share)
- confirm PD contact/phone numbers
- verify access to prod dashboards: grafana, traces, logs
- show common mitigations: rolling restart, redis circuit breaker, db query kill
- confirm who owns DB alerts
- confirm backup on-call (if primary goes unreachable)
```
Mira Patel: I’ll run through that list with Priya. Priya — do you have access to the prod Grafana yet?
Priya Kapoor: I have read-only Grafana but I don’t have sudo on the rotator. working with infra to get that today.
ops-rotations: Roster snapshot:
```
Fri 18:00-02:00 - Alex Chen (handoff) -> Mira Patel (primary) / Sam Ortiz (secondary)
Sat 02:00-10:00 - Jess Rivera (primary) / Alex Chen (secondary)
```
Alex Chen: quick note on paging etiquette — when you page the primary include: brief symptom, severity, customer impact, last action. example: 'Pager: high 503s on /completion - 20% of traffic failing, rollback triggered'. avoids noise.
Sam Ortiz: also add the runbook link in the PD ticket. people often forget.
Jess Rivera: for Priya onboarding: I suggest first-shadow handles only monitoring-level tasks (no direct mitigation) for the first 2 incidents unless mentor says otherwise. then gradual ramp.
Priya Kapoor: sounds good. can someone DM me a tiny checklist for the first shadow so I can prep?
Mira Patel: will DM checklist + pairing link 30 mins before. also we’ll do a post-shift debrief in DM or here if anything noteworthy happened.
Alex Chen: last => small automation note: use `rota status` on ops-cli to verify current primary/secondary. if mismatch, ping ops-rotations.
Sam Ortiz: I’ll be on call and will test PD notify with a test page at 18:05 — will mark test in channel.
Mira Patel: perfect. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Test page: sent to Sam Ortiz at 18:05 (no escalation)
Alex Chen: action items: Mira run runbook + DM Priya, Sam standby as secondary, Jess available for SRE lead escalation, Priya shadow at 17:30. closing thread unless anyone has objections.
Priya Kapoor: no objections — see you all tomorrow and thanks for the onboarding plan! :smile:
